name: Tissues and Organs

papers.title: Linking vascular pathways to organ anatomical structures in the Human Reference Atlas
papers.abstract: As part of the Human Reference Atlas (HRA) initiative, which brings together more than 25 international consortia to map the entire healthy adult body, we developed a multiscale Vasculature Common Coordinate Framework (VCCF). The VCCF uses vascular pathways to describe the location of organs, anatomical structures, and cells throughout the body. Here, we present the VCCF Blood Vasculature Organ Crosswalk, which links blood vessels to anatomical structures they supply or drain, and the Pathways Crosswalk, which lists relationships between blood vessels, lymphatic vessels, and nerves. Blood Vasculature Organ Crosswalk Diagrams support the authoring and review of the crosswalk tables. In machine readable files, we catalog 349 blood vessels from these diagrams, with 663 linkages to 295 anatomical structures across 20 organs/body regions and 28 functional tissue units. The VCCF crosswalk tables and diagrams have been validated algorithmically and by 11 organ experts. They have brought together experts from different domains to document existing knowledge of the human vasculature and identify gaps where future research is needed.
